line.a_przeprowadzka.text: Hooray! Today I'm moving house. My new burrow is in the birch wood.

line.a_pomozemy.text: We'll help you carry your things, Mole!

line.a_rzeczy.text: Thank you! We're taking my barrel and my long stick.

line.a_furtka.text: First we have to get through this gate.

line.a_zaklad.text: The barrel is short, it will surely go through! But the stick is long. That one won't fit.

line.a_beczka.text: Let's check. Push the barrel through the gate.

line.a_utknela.text: Oh no! The barrel got stuck in the gate.

line.a_jak_to.text: How come? The barrel is short!

line.a_kij.text: Now push the long stick through the gate.

line.a_przeszedl.text: The long stick went through the gate!

line.a_waska.text: Look. The gate is narrow. Only something thin can go through it.

line.a_cienki.text: The stick is long, but it is thin, so it went through. The barrel is short, but it is thick.

line.a_jak_beczka.text: So how will we carry my thick barrel?

line.a_brama.text: Next to the gate there is a wide gateway!

line.a_ktora.text: Which way will the thick barrel go through? Push it.

line.a_ktora_nie.text: The gate is too narrow for the thick barrel.

line.a_ktora_tak.text: Yes! The thick barrel went through the wide gateway.

line.a_do_lasu.text: Everything is through. Off to the birch wood!

line.b_las.text: This is the birch wood. My new burrow is close now.

line.b_polana.text: I'm also carrying three logs for my stove.

line.b_lisek.text: The path goes between these birches. Every log will go through, they're short!

line.b_brzozy.text: It's narrow between the birches. Which log will fit? Push it through.

line.b_brzozy_nie.text: That log is too thick. It got stuck between the birches.

line.b_brzozy_tak.text: The thinnest log went through! We'll carry the thick logs around.

line.b_najgrubsze.text: My burrow is under the thickest tree in the wood. But I see so badly...

line.b_pomozemy.text: We'll help you! Point to the thickest tree.

line.b_drzewo_nie.text: This tree has a thinner trunk. Look for the thickest one.

line.b_drzewo_tak.text: Yes! This tree has the thickest trunk. I live here!

line.c_bloto.text: Oh dear! The doormat in front of my door is all muddy.

line.c_zetrzyj.text: Rub the mud off with your finger! There's something underneath.

line.c_odkryte.text: All clean! Something is painted here.

line.c_kto.text: Point to who is painted on the doormat.

line.c_kto_nie.text: These are only flowers. Look for the animal.

line.c_kto_tak.text: It's a mole, just like me! Now everyone knows who lives here.

line.c_tunele.text: Two tunnels lead into my burrow: a narrow one and a wide one.

line.c_tunele2.text: Only thin things go down the narrow tunnel. Thick things fit into the wide one.

line.c_wloz.text: Put the thin things into the narrow tunnel and the thick things into the wide one.

line.c_wloz_nie.text: Something doesn't fit. Thin things into the narrow tunnel, thick things into the wide one.

line.c_wloz_tak.text: The thin things are in the narrow tunnel and the thick things in the wide one. Everything fitted!

line.c_wszystko.text: Everything is in its place in my burrow now!

line.c_dziekuje.text: Thank you! Without you nothing would have fitted in here.

line.c_parapetowka.text: Tomorrow I'm having a housewarming party. You're invited!

line.p_start.text: Now let's play: what will fit? I have five games!

line.p_kredka_nie.text: This crayon is thinner. Look for the thicker one.

line.p_drzewo.text: Which tree has the thinner trunk?

line.p_drzewo_nie.text: This trunk is thicker. Look for the thinner one.

line.p_drzewo_tak.text: Yes, this tree has the thinner trunk.

line.p_wstazka_nie.text: This ribbon is narrower. Look for the wider one.

line.p_wezsza.text: Now point to the narrower ribbon.

line.p_wezsza_nie.text: This ribbon is wider. Look for the narrower one.

line.p_szpara.text: There is a narrow gap in the wall. What will go through it? Push it through.

line.p_szpara_nie.text: The pumpkin is too thick. It got stuck in the gap.

line.p_szpara_tak.text: Yes, the thin stick went through the narrow gap.

line.p_kolejka.text: Put the crayons in order from the thinnest to the thickest.

line.p_kolejka_tak.text: Thin, middle and thick. All in order!

line.p_grube_nie.text: The ribbon is wide. Look for something thick.

line.p_grube_tak.text: Yes, the round crayon is thick.

line.p_szerokie.text: Now point to what is wide.

line.p_szerokie_nie.text: The crayon is thick. Look for something wide.

line.p_szerokie_tak.text: Yes, the flat ribbon is wide.

line.d_dom.text: Today is my housewarming party! The guests will be here soon.

line.d_balagan.text: We brought so many things! Let's tidy up before the guests come.

line.d_parasol.text: This umbrella is so long! It won't fit into the narrow stand.

line.d_pamietasz.text: Long? Remember the long stick and the narrow gate?

line.d_stojak.text: What will fit into the narrow stand? Put it in.

line.d_stojak_nie.text: The thick book won't fit. The stand is narrow.

line.d_stojak_tak.text: The umbrella is long, but it is thin. It fitted!

line.d_ksiazki.text: We'll stand the books on the shelf.

line.d_uloz.text: Put the books in order from the thinnest to the thickest.

line.d_uloz_tak.text: The thinnest, the middle one and the thickest. Nicely in order!

line.d_zimno.text: Brr, my neck is cold. Which scarf will be the warmest?

line.d_szalik.text: The widest one is the warmest. Point to the widest scarf.

line.d_szalik_nie.text: This scarf is narrower. Look for the widest one.

line.d_puk.text: Knock, knock! The guests are here. One present needs the door opened wide.

line.d_prezent_nie.text: This present is narrower. Look for the widest one.

line.d_prezent_tak.text: Yes, the picture is the widest. Let's open the door wide!

line.d_obraz.text: What a beautiful wide picture! It came in through the wide open door.

line.d_kredki.text: My crayon is thin, and Mole's crayon is thick.

line.d_rodzice.text: Play this at home with your parents. Find something thicker than your finger and something thinner.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for helping me move house! Here is a sticker for your album, as a keepsake. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is Mole's new burrow. He gave it to us when we helped him move and learnt that what is thin or narrow fits, even when it is long.
